prompt:

Asset type: NPC talking portrait mouth animation atlas for a 64x29 lower-half pixel-art face
Primary request: Create a 3x3 atlas of the SAME original woman's lower-face half, repeated in each cell, preserving the exact framing and identity from Image 1. Each cell is 64:29 aspect, arranged row-major A B C / D E F / G H X. This atlas is for the SAD emotion: subtly downturned lip corners and subdued tension, with quiet brown lips. Keep sadness restrained, not an exaggerated upside-down U. Change only the mouth pose in each cell.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole visual/reference image and is the supplied mouth reference grid. Match its lower-face composition and original art exactly; use it only as the guide for face, identity, palette, grid and pixel scale.
Style/medium: faithful native-resolution 1990s pixel-art portrait, enlarged nearest-neighbor pixels, softly blended but clearly discrete pixels; no smooth vector rendering, no painterly restyling.
Color palette: original muted warm tan skin, soft brown lips and restrained warm tooth/cavity tones. Keep the same lip scale and face width. No lipstick red, orange skin, bright white tooth blocks, or excessive contrast.
Constraints: Output only the complete repeated-face 3x3 atlas on the same 64:29 cell proportions and overall 3:3 atlas structure as Image 1. Keep nose base, cheeks, chin, hair, neck, and background aligned and unchanged. Preserve original shading and pixels outside the lips/mouth interior. Sad emotion remains subtle in every pose. Include these actual Rhubarb viseme meanings, faithfully, not arbitrary letter shapes: A closed lightly pressured P/B/M lips; B narrow horizontal opening with teeth nearly together for consonants/EE; C medium relaxed unrounded EH/AE opening; D wide vertical AA opening, larger than C; E slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C; F small forward pucker for UW/OW/W, not tooth biting; G upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V, not a wide vowel or pucker; H tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D (tiny tongue may be nearly invisible at 64px); X relaxed closed idle. Sadness changes corner direction and tension gently without changing these pose families. Keep teeth small, subdued warm ivory only where required, with readable dark cavity. Do not enlarge mouth or face.
Avoid: exaggerated frown or upside-down U, giant open mouths, arbitrary same pose in all cells, incorrect F/G shapes, red lipstick, orange surrounding skin, bright white teeth, changed face contour, text, labels, borders, watermark.
